note: Race 3 has no published start time, so its forecast is read at an estimated 16:30Z first beat. Race 4's gun is not published either, but all three 9 September loggers record it at 12:55:00Z to the second, so its forecast is read at the first beat's midpoint, about 13:10Z.
trend: The bias is not a constant, and it is not noise either — it decays. Across four races it ran +19.1, +18.0, +11.2 and +6.7 degrees, falling every single time. Wednesday's race needed less than half Tuesday's correction. Use the latest measured value, not the mean; the mean of +13.8 already over-corrects the most recent race by seven degrees.
